Episode 184. Beyond Fate (17)
Crack, Creak...!
The lower part of Ram began to trample on the Malevolent God's fortress.
The left hand of Vahn, which was pulling Ram, was trembling with an enormous force.
"Kaaaaa!"
As Vahn let out a yell and slammed his left hand down fiercely, Ram finally collapsed on the ground, crushing the Malevolent God's fortress.
Its massive volume and mass were crushing the fortress. The Malevolent God, trapped in the lightning of the Heavenly King's Sword, just watched the scene.
A continuous sequence of shock and astonishment.
The Malevolent God alternately looked at Ram and Vahn, as if unable to comprehend the crashed Ram.

Ram was utterly shattered. The main cannon located at the lower center had completely distorted and lost its shape, and although the upper part could not be seen, it must have been cracked dry like drought-stricken land.
All this happened only a few minutes after the divine union unfolded.
Vahn was far beyond the common sense of those who had directly experienced the 'creation', including the Malevolent God.
'How on earth did the gods of the past win against this monster?'
The Malevolent God acknowledged that she was a rank below the supreme gods.
That's why she deliberately didn't acquire perfect divinity.
If he became a real god, he would have to be one order that encompasses the world, destruction itself, not the lord of Runcandel.
However, even though it was incomplete, since he had obtained divinity, he was convinced that nothing among mortals could threaten him. That is, until he met Vahn.
'Even then, all of her kind must have been together. Maybe it was my mistake not to get the real divinity in the first place.'
The Malevolent God was getting impatient.
Just like when he decided to join hands with the prophet, it seemed like a dead-end wall was blocking him from all sides and squeezing him.
The lightning of the Heavenly King's Sword was eating away at the bodies of Ram and the Malevolent God. The Malevolent God closely watched that the lightning did not become larger.
'... Is it because if it gets fiercer, it can sweep away the allies?'
The reason why the lightning did not strike beyond a certain level was clear. It was because if it got fiercer, it could sweep away the temporary alliance.
Then, she should have taken hostages, but that seemed impossible.
There's no way that the monster in front of him would be fooled by such petty tricks.
'That way won't work. I have to find something else.'
He still had some power left. It was just that even if he poured out all of it, he couldn't picture beating Vahn.
Should she acquire complete divinity now?
However, losing the power he gave to Diphus hurt him deeply.
From the start, if he still had that power, he wouldn't have been pushed this far.
[The Jin brothers, though you are their mother and enemy, said you were someone who could take care of the clan for a while. Is it for such a power that you betrayed the Jin brothers' trust?]
[Just? You're a parasite on the youngest, barely surviving after being destroyed half a million years ago, and you're talking big. Do you think it's all over?]
The body of the Malevolent God bound by the lightning began to dissipate into smoke.
[I admit that I can't beat you. But summoning you is a kind of coercion from the youngest. If my guess is correct, it won't last long.]
The duration, that was the only weakness of the divine union.
'I have to endure until that time ends. For that, I have no choice but to increase divinity, even if it's overdoing it.'
Increasing divinity, getting closer to the god.
Since Diphus was already lost, it was impossible to transcend into a complete god, but with Ram, he could enhance the divinity.
That was a gamble for the Malevolent God. If careless, her ego could be erased and become a monstrous entity left with nothing but a desire for destruction.
Even if she wins in this battle in such a state, there's nothing left.
There would be no point in the clan to protect, the land to rule, or the power she gained at such a great cost.
But there was no choice.
The Malevolent God, who had been limiting the choices of Jin and the temporary alliance, and humanity, was now placed in a compulsory situation.
Of course, Vahn saw through the Malevolent God's thoughts.
[Awakening, that's an act that suits humans.]
The lightning of the Heavenly King's Sword became even more ferocious.
The body of the Malevolent God, which was scattering into smoke, was evaporating at a rapid speed.
But the smoke continued to go towards Ram while disappearing.
One by one, black spots appeared on Ram's hull, dyed in blue.
Every time, Vahn struck lightning on the spots, but the speed of creating spots was faster.
The spots meant the fusion of the Malevolent God and Ram.
Just as Jin unfolded the divine union, the Malevolent God was also becoming one with Ram.
[Becoming one with something and amplifying power is not a blessing permitted only to you, youngest.]
Although he admitted he could never surpass Vahn, the Malevolent God was the Malevolent God.
She had power. While fusing herself into Ram, she kept aiming at the allied fleet with the remaining spirit.
Even with the Heavenly King's Sword, the Guardian Brothers, and the shield, they couldn't completely block the mental contamination caused by the spirit.
One by one, those infected by the spirit began to appear.
Even Orgal was on the verge of turning black because he was protecting too many people.
Don't worry about us, keep fighting!
The allies couldn't dare to shout that.
If the spiritual energy, which is already overwhelming, gets even stronger with the lightning, the entire allied formation could collapse.
That was the basis for the Malevolent God to hastily decide on fusion.
[Deciding to fuse with the witch's warship just means that there is one less thing for me to destroy.]
But Vahn amplified his energy without hesitation.
While Vahn knew better than anyone that the allies could be swept away, there was one reason why he still pulled up his strength.
It was because she was confident.
He had the confidence to make sure that none of the allies would die, even if he unfolded the next chapter of the Heavenly King's Sword, and he was certain that he could do it.
Heavenly King's Sword Divine Technique, Tenth Sword
Heavenly King's Sword - Conclusion
A blue sea.
As soon as the last decision of the Heavenly King's Sword started, a blue sea unfolded on the ground.
It wasn't just a figure of speech, the lightning just gently swayed like calm waves.
The protective shields spread out everywhere, the spirits piercing through them, and the people standing below.
They were not damaged by the divine energy of the sword that reached their ankles. The lightning, rippling like water, did not emit the destructive energy unique to the Heavenly King's Sword.
But everyone knew.
How much power that seemingly harmless lightning had, enough to completely evaporate the endless and vast real sea and still have some left...
Such an indescribably immense power.
Vahn stood tall in the middle of the waves of lightning without any action.
The spirits constantly sticking to the hull of Ram were gently being sucked into the waves.
No matter how many spirits were sucked in, the sea of divinity didn't get murky. On the contrary, it only shone clearer.
It was clear enough to reflect faces if one lowered their head. People were fascinated by the light and unknowingly fixed their gaze on the sea of lightning.
The ground and the empty space contrasted each other.

The low-lying Ram in the empty space was dark as if swallowing all the light in the world, while the sea of lightning that covered the ground caused a brilliant glow, enough to momentarily forget that this place was a battlefield where the survival of humanity was at stake.
The fusion and the conclusion of the Heavenly King's Sword were nearly completed at the same time.
The Malevolent God was reaching the final critical point of fusion.
The ego of Runcandel, which she tried to protect even without becoming a perfect god, was shaking as a whole and was at risk of extinction.
On the other hand, the divine was certain of victory.
From the moment the conclusion was drawn, she noticed that the voice of Jin, which had been heard from within, disappeared.
'Jin brothers.'
There was no response. Even after calling several times, Jin showed no reaction at all.
'Vahn! Jin is disappearing...!'
Instead, Lingling's voice came through.
Her voice also sounded infinitely distant and small.
Vahn intuitively knew that something had gone wrong.
The reason Lingling's voice was so small was because he was barely holding onto Jin's ego, which had been pushed to the deepest part of Vahn.
Lingling was doing everything he could to prevent Jin's ego from completely disappearing.
The union of the divine is a martial art that borrows the power of the divine.
However, Jin was now beyond that, he was practically summoning the divine through his body.
Synchronization.
From the moment the union of the divine started to the present, the continuously rising synchronization without any reason was the cause.
The synchronization peaked and eventually took over Jin's body without Vahn's intent, and was now resulting in eroding even his ego.
This quickly disturbed Vahn's mind.
If he continued with the conclusion as it is, he would certainly be able to destroy the Malevolent God, but Jin would also inevitably disappear.
'You can't use more strength, Vahn! This idiot won't be able to endure it! No, he's already not enduring it, I'm just holding him!'
Vahn closed his eyes.
Is it right to stop now?
Would the Jin brothers really want that?
As if a storm had come, the sea of lightning following Vahn's dizzy inner self was showing an unstable flow.
Soon, Vahn made a decision.
[Lingling, focus your mind from now on and read Jin brothers' will.]
'What!?'
[Find out what the Jin brothers want. What is he saying?]
'How can I read that while he's being sucked into Vahn's unconscious...!'
[You can do it. Because you're holding onto the Jin brothers. Hurry!]
As she held onto Jin, Lingling followed Vahn's words. While the strength of the mouth and hands that were biting Jin loosened, really.
A very small sense of Jin's will being conveyed to her own inner self continued. Jin, with more than 90% of his ego buried, was transmitting a clear will.
'Continue... continue? Hey, you're going to die like this! You'll disappear without a trace!'
As soon as he heard that, Vahn put strength into the hand holding the sword.
Then, glaring at Ram, who had become one with the Malevolent God, he said this.
[If the Jin brothers said so, it means the brothers can endure it. No matter how painful it is, I won't let myself kill the brothers. I will follow the Jin brothers' will.]
